Maybe this question have already been answered , but i cant find the
answer.

If a card Require a ready Anarch , for example diversion , does the
vampire who play it have to be Anarch ?

Example :If vamp A is Sabbat and want to play diversion. Can he play
it if vamp B is Anarch ? (I also control vamp B in this Scenario).

I think not because if i refer to the ruling about Shadow Court Satyr
and Diversion , he cant play it because he is not a ready Anarch.

Thx ,

Mechadick

"Mechadick" <mech...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:397ee008.04102...@posting.google.com...

> Maybe this question have already been answered , but i cant find the
> answer.
>
> If a card Require a ready Anarch , for example diversion , does the
> vampire who play it have to be Anarch ?

If a card requires anything, the requirements must be met, yes.
Rulebook: " Only a minion who meets the requirements given on a minion
card can play it, while only a Methuselah who controls a ready minion
who meets the requirements of a master card can play it."
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec1_6_1

> Example :If vamp A is Sabbat and want to play diversion. Can he play
> it if vamp B is Anarch ? (I also control vamp B in this Scenario).

No.

> I think not because if i refer to the ruling about Shadow Court Satyr
> and Diversion , he cant play it because he is not a ready Anarch.

Right.
